==Summary==

{{pov|[[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}}

Nynaeve and [[Daigian]] consider the constant overcast of the last week. Daigian is teaching the standard one hundred weaves to Nynaeve. She considers the weaves useless, far too complex for the function they serve. Nynaeve effortlessly completes each weave. Daigian, being among the weakest in the [[One Power]] Nynaeve has ever seen, will always be ranked lowest when in the company of other sisters. Nynaeve complains how these intricate social codes are wrong, letting a woman's strength in the power determine position, when Daigian has as much, or more knowledge than any other Sister. 

She sees the [[Aiel]] arriving in camp, and hurries off, to join [[Rand]], [[Davram Bashere]], [[Rhuarc]], [[Bair]], [[Amys]], [[Aviendha]], [[Bael]], [[Cadsuane]] and others in the tents, discussing the plan for [[Bandar Eban]]. Rand wants to know how far the Aiel have come to establishing peace in Arad Doman. Bael pushes back, saying Rand gives them orders then follows up just weeks later demanding results. Rand is on the verge of losing his temper when Cadsuane cuts in with an admonishment and reminds him the Aiel have not failed him and won't begin. Rhuarc is ordered to capture the members [[Merchant's Council]], who are scattered in their home cities. Rand considers this to be protection from the [[Forsaken]] as well as gathering the Council to choose a new king. Rhuarc asks about [[Rodel Ituralde|Ituralde]], and how he plays into all of this. Rand is determined to deal with him personally.
